input.quote: 13.2 For software and Vendor Technology delivered to Customer on a paid-up basis or embedded in a Deliverable, Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, modify, create derivative works from, and permit contractors to support that material for Customer's business.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position on all material terms. The subscription grant in 13.1 expressly extends to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice condition required), plus Authorized Users. The paid-up grant in 13.2 is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, with contractor support rights. Clause 13.3 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor via an assignment permitted by Section 24, and § 24.1 allows assignment to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent, with § 24.4 barring Vendor from terminating, repricing or suspending on our change of control. Revocation/suspension is confined to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the licence is not revocable at will. The § 1.1 "Affiliate" definition is standard >50% control. No redline required.
